title_sq: Perballe Harry Fultz, Shitet Apartament 2+1 I Investuar Totalisht!!

title_en: Opposite Harry Fultz, Fully Invested 2+1 Apartment For Sale!!
description_en: In front of Harry Fultz, 2+1 apartment for sale, ideal for investment!!! The apartment is located on the 4th floor of a well-managed building. The apartment has an area of ​​70 m2 and is organized by a living room with a kitchenette, a matrimonial bedroom, a bedroom for children and a toilet. The apartment is fully invested, starting from the electrical and plumbing installations, the completely reconstructed toilet, parquet, doors, windows, as well as the furniture together with the appliances. The area in which the apartment is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life as well as for investment, since there are high demands for rent. The apartment has regular mortgage documentation.
